ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85-90% high-intensity (white) pixels dominating the ventral surface with a sharp 10-15% low-intensity (black) border localized at the edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white area covering the central and lateral regions of both lobes; black pigmentation forms a continuous fringe along the trailing edge and becomes dense at the distal tips; a localized dark triangular region is visible at the inferior peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated acute angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge; serrations are most pronounced and irregular on the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the upper boundary of both lobes, tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast cluster of approximately 15-20 circular, three-dimensional pixel groupings (barnacles) localized on the outer margin of the right lobe tip; scattered low-contrast circular depressions visible across the white surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed in the lower-central region of the right lobe and center-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on the far right lobe tip; heavily irregular and jagged trailing edge topography indicating historical tissue loss or trauma.
